title: Review report
description: One read-only reviewer lane: verdicts on earlier findings, then new findings. Finding ids are assigned by the script.

reviewed_sha.description: The commit whose diff was reviewed, as given in the prompt. A review of any other commit is discarded.

verifications.description: One entry per implementer response in the prompt. A finding stays open until a reviewer marks it resolved or dispute_accepted and no reviewer marks it unresolved.

evidence.description: File and line, or the command run, that shows the verdict.

findings.description: New problems in this round's diff.

criterion_id.description: Acceptance criterion it affects, or empty string.

test_case_id.description: Test case it affects, if any.

severity.description: blocking: wrong behaviour, a criterion or test case not met, a project rule broken, or cost that grows with table or history size. Everything else is minor.

issue.description: What is wrong, in one or two sentences.

evidence.description: Code quoted, input that breaks it, or the plan.

check.description: How the next reviewer confirms it is fixed.

incidental.description: Anything noticed outside this lane or this diff.

findings.issue: version-at-time reads every saved version of each order before keeping one.
findings.evidence: DISTINCT ON over the UNION ALL; an order with 2000 versions reads all of them.
findings.check: EXPLAIN shows a backward index scan under LIMIT 1 per order.
